boundaries: Published provider documentation is capability/retention evidence, not proof that EMOPET has an active production account or configuration.
A documented TTL is not an erasure receipt for a specific EMOPET subject.
A provider privacy right or support process is not an application-level automated deletion integration.
Provider policy evidence must be re-verified before production launch and after material provider/model/product changes.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: Contact notification email body may contain contact coordinate/value, user message, proposed slots, request id and request context.

retention: Email and log data: 30 days on Free, Pro and Scale while the account is active; Enterprise retention can be flexible.
Remaining customer data: deleted within 90 days after account termination.
publicEvidence.earlyRemoval: Resend states that a specific message can be removed before the retention window by contacting Resend.
publicEvidence.programmaticDeletion: Contact records have a delete API, but no sent-email-content delete API relevant to this EMOPET notification flow was established by the reviewed official evidence.

emopetErasureReadiness.reason: The current notification flow discards the provider email object id after send and does not send a canonical EMOPET subject id.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: Breiz sends a bounded user message plus generated regional/system context to the Messages API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is configured.

retention: Anthropic commercial API inputs and outputs are deleted from backend systems within 30 days by default.
Different retention can apply where agreed, including eligible zero-data-retention arrangements.
Covered Models can require 30-day retention even where ZDR would otherwise apply.
Usage-policy and legal exceptions can require longer retention.
publicEvidence.programmaticDeletion: No per-request subject deletion mechanism relevant to the current Messages API flow was established by the reviewed official evidence.

emopetErasureReadiness.reason: The request contains user-authored text/context but the current route does not send a canonical EMOPET account id or persist a provider request id.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: Mapbox GL map requests are client-side when a public token is configured; the component also exposes a high-accuracy GeolocateControl.

retention: Mapbox product privacy documentation states IP addresses are deleted after 30 days, subject to limited investigation/legal exceptions.
For geolocation data, the session-id association is described as broken within 24 hours.
publicEvidence.deletionRights: Mapbox documents deletion rights/request channels for applicable personal data.

emopetErasureReadiness.reason: The current integration does not attach EMOPET user/dog identifiers to Mapbox requests.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: The current root integration loads the standard Plausible script with data-domain only; no EMOPET user id or custom property is configured there.

retention: Plausible states raw IP addresses and full User-Agent values are never stored.
A daily identifier is derived with a rotating salt; old salts are deleted every 24 hours.
Plausible states it does not create persistent visitor identifiers and site measurement is aggregate.
Plausible account/site data can be deleted and is permanently removed without undue delay.

emopetErasureReadiness.reason: Current repository integration does not send user id, dog id, precise location or custom subject properties to Plausible.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: Weather requests may include latitude/longitude and naturally expose the request IP to the provider.

retention: Open-Meteo states free API server logs may contain IP addresses and geographical coordinates for troubleshooting.
Open-Meteo states all such log files are deleted after 90 days.

emopetErasureReadiness.reason: The current flow is coordinate/context based rather than account-id based.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: Backend weather requests send latitude/longitude plus the EMOPET OpenWeatherMap API key when OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY is configured.

publicEvidence.confirmedCapability: Official API documentation confirms weather requests accept latitude/longitude.

repositoryFlow.dataBoundary: Viewport bounding-box POI queries are sent to the public Overpass endpoint; no EMOPET account/dog identifier is attached.
